deepcfr_policy.pth.rules: no free fold (fold only when facing a bet), 100-chip stacks, blinds 1/2, fold / call / min-raise / all-in, 3rd raise -> all-in
deepcfr_policy.pth.algorithm: DeepCFR average-strategy net; features=history (DeepCFR paper bet history), arch=paper, cards=embed, dim 64, uniform RM fallback
deepcfr_policy.pth.advantage_fit: 4000 steps x 16384, Adam 1e-3, from scratch each iteration
deepcfr_policy.pth.memories: reservoir 20M advantage samples per seat, 20M strategy samples
deepcfr_policy.pth.lbr_chips_per_hand: 1.25 +- 0.07 (10 000 duplicate pairs, 2026-10-08: flop equities enumerated, showdowns averaged over the range; 1.33 +- 0.09 with the estimator before its hand-selection fix)
deepcfr_policy.pth.best_response_exploitability: not re-measured yet with the corrected estimator (the 2026-08 figure of 1620 mbb/g missed the board chance factor)

blueprint_nlhe.pt.algorithm: tabular Pluribus-style MCCFR-P blueprint (headsup.blueprint): Linear MCCFR with negative-regret pruning, 169 lossless preflop classes + 200 equal-mass EHS buckets per later round (Monte-Carlo EHS, 500 runouts), 20M iterations; average strategy accumulated at the sampled opponent infosets (the 2026-08-17 version weighted it by the opponent's reach); play-only file (average-strategy counters, no regrets)
blueprint_nlhe.pt.lbr_chips_per_hand: 1.03 +- 0.10 (10 000 duplicate pairs, 2026-10-08; the 0.60 +- 0.09 measured before came from an LBR that kept the first hands to finish among lock-step tables)
blueprint_nlhe.pt.head_to_head: +0.86 +- 0.02 chips/hand vs models/deepcfr_policy.pth (400 000 hands, all-in EV, 2026-10-08; +0.87 +- 0.04 before)
blueprint_nlhe.pt.note: an equilibrium approximation exploits fixed bots less than the DeepCFR nets do; use it with real-time search: python -m headsup.web --opponent pluribus
blueprint_nlhe.pt.search: pluribus (this blueprint + Pluribus-mode search, after the 2026-10-08 fidelity changes): +0.40 +- 0.29 chips/hand vs the blueprint itself (2 000 hands)
blueprint_nlhe.pt.candidates_2026-10-08: trained with the current code (deterministic buckets, scaled pruning threshold), table abstraction + pruning 5e-5: 20 M iterations +0.05 +- 0.02 vs this file, LBR 1.14 +- 0.10; 200 M iterations +0.07 +- 0.02, LBR 1.33 +- 0.10 - not clearly better, not shipped
